headline: AI tools leak over 13,000 sensitive internal screenshots
summary: A security report found that AI tools have exposed more than 13,000 publicly accessible screenshots revealing internal, sensitive work from inside tech companies, with one outlet saying the images came from over 300 companies and were posted to public GitHub repositories.

claims.statement: AI tools have exposed more than 13,000 screenshots revealing sensitive internal company data.

sources.quote: more than 13,000 publicly accessible images that expose corporate development work
AI agents inadvertently leak 13,000+ internal screenshots from organizations

claims.statement: The leaked screenshots came from over 300 companies and were uploaded to public GitHub repositories.

sources.quote: AI agents have been quietly uploading internal screenshots from over 300 companies to public GitHub repos
